_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'PROJECT CHARTER' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-03.01.

f01_Project_purpose.label: Project purpose
f01_Project_purpose.guidance: The reason the project is being undertaken. May refer to a business case, the organization’s strategic plan, external factors, a contract agreement, or any other reason for performing the project.

f02_High_level_project_description.label: High-level project description
f02_High_level_project_description.guidance: A summary-level description of the project detailing its core scope and business context.

f03_Project_boundaries.label: Project boundaries
f03_Project_boundaries.guidance: Limits to the project scope. May include scope exclusions, or other limitations.

f04_Key_deliverables.label: Key deliverables
f04_Key_deliverables.guidance: The high-level project and product deliverables. These will be further elaborated in the project scope statement.

f05_High_level_requirements.label: High-level requirements
f05_High_level_requirements.guidance: The high-level conditions or capabilities that must be met to satisfy the purpose of the project. Describe the product features and functions that must be present to meet stakeholders’ needs and expectations. These will be further elaborated in the requirements documentation.

f06_High_level_assumptions_and_constrain.label: High-level assumptions and constraints
f06_High_level_assumptions_and_constrain.guidance: High-level assumptions are factors considered to be true, real, or certain without proof or demonstration. Constraints are limiting factors that affect the execution of a project, program, portfolio, or process.

f07_Overall_project_risk.label: Overall project risk
f07_Overall_project_risk.guidance: An assessment of the overall riskiness of the project. Overall risk can include the underlying political, social, economic, and technological volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity. It pertains to the stakeholder exposure to variations in the project outcome.

f08_Project_objectives_and_related_succe.section: Project objectives and related success criteria
f08_Project_objectives_and_related_succe.label: Project objectives and related success criteria
f08_Project_objectives_and_related_succe.guidance: Project objectives are usually established for at least scope, schedule, and cost. The success criteria identify the metrics or measurements that will be used to measure success.

f09_Summary_milestone_schedule.label: Summary milestone schedule
f09_Summary_milestone_schedule.guidance: Significant events in the project. Examples include the completion of key deliverables, the beginning or completion of a project phase, or product acceptance.

f10_Preapproved_financial_resources.label: Preapproved financial resources
f10_Preapproved_financial_resources.guidance: The amount of funding available for the project. May include sources of funding and annual funding limits.

f11_Key_stakeholder_list.label: Key stakeholder list
f11_Key_stakeholder_list.guidance: An initial, high-level list of people or groups that have influenced or can influence project success, as well as those who are influenced by its success.

f12_Project_exit_criteria.label: Project exit criteria
f12_Project_exit_criteria.guidance: The performance, metrics, conditions, or other measurements that must be met to conclude the project.

f13_Project_approval_requirements.label: Project approval requirements
f13_Project_approval_requirements.guidance: Defines what constitutes project success, who determines whether the project is successful, and who signs off on the project.

f14_Project_manager_authority_level.label: Project manager authority level
f14_Project_manager_authority_level.guidance: The authority of the project manager with regard to staffing decisions, budget management and variance, technical decisions, and conflict resolution.

f15_Name_and_authority_of_the_sponsor.section: Name and authority of the sponsor
f15_Name_and_authority_of_the_sponsor.label: Name and authority of the sponsor
f15_Name_and_authority_of_the_sponsor.guidance: Name and authority of the sponsor or other person(s) authorizing the project charter.
